ينتهب (form VIII)

# يُنْتَهَبُ (yuntahabu) /jun.ta.ha.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
# يَنْتَهِبَ (yantahiba) /jan.ta.hi.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
